---
title: "Download MGLTools"
---

The installers are on GitHub, in the releases of
[sannerlab/downloads](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases).

## Patched versions of 1.5.7 and 1.5.6

These patched builds supersede the latest stable releases of 1.5.6 and 1.5.7.

**October 29, 2022**

- The installation folder is determined at run time, so an installation tree can be moved and
  still work.
- The Python interpreter in the `bin` folder of the installation is now called
  `MGLPython<$PyVersion>`, to avoid interfering with the system Python.
- `pythonsh` and the other scripts in the `bin` folder set `PYTHONNOUSERSITE="disabled"`, so that
  packages from the user site-packages (such as `~/.local/lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages`) are not
  imported.

**November 2, 2022**

- Bug fix in the BRIX parser of the Volume package, in the calculation of grid spacing variables.

## Fixing registration

The MGLTools registration can be patched to work again:

1. Download the patch script [patchRegistration.py](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/mgltools-1.5.7/patchRegistration.py).
2. Run it with the MGLTools Python interpreter:

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Linux
```bash
$WhereYouInstalledMGLtools/bin/pythonsh patchRegistration.py ccsbserver
```
### macOS
```bash
/Library/MGLTools/1.5.6/bin/pythonsh patchRegistration.py ccsbserver
```
### Windows
```
C:\Program Files (X86)\MGLTools-1.5.6\bin\python patchRegistration.py ccsbserver
```
:::

The program should display:

```
patching file: $WhereYouInstalledMGLtools/ … /mglutil/splashregister/register.py
line xxx replacing: mgldev.scripps.edu:80 by orca.scripps.edu:80
line xxx replacing: www.scripps.edu:80 by orca.scripps.edu:80
do you wish to proceed Y/[n]
```

If the substitutions look the same, press `y`. The original file is kept with a `.bak` extension.
Then start PMV and register.
